summary: The first stop is the lit-candle branch of objnam.c:doname_base while zap.c:makewish formats the wish result. C then continues to throw the Wizard’s starting magic marker with input n; the candle is only the naming probe, so this recording does not exercise candle extinguishing. After the marker lands, JS records apply.c:snuff_candle as a later gap, but C returns false immediately for that non-candle.

source.branch: In doname_base(), a wished object satisfies Is_candle(obj) and obj->lamplit while its BURN_OBJECT timer is active. The TOOL_CLASS naming branch adjusts obj->age by peek_timer(BURN_OBJECT, &timer) - svm.moves before comparing turns_left with 20 * objects[obj->otyp].oc_cost, then appends the lit suffix.
callers: objnam.c:doname() (1753-1757) calls doname_base with ordinary flags. The observed route is cmd.c:extcmdlist["wizwish"] -> wizcmds.c:wiz_wish() -> zap.c:makewish() -> doname(otmp) at zap.c:6388.
objnam.c:doname_with_price(), doname_vague_quan(), and paydoname() are the other direct wrappers into doname_base (objnam.c:1761-1764, 1782, 2326); they are not reached by this recording.

After the wish-result string, zap.c:makewish() may format the added object through invent.c:hold_another_object() -> prinv() -> xprname() -> doname(); that second render is later than the failing call.
dependencies: objnam.c:xname(obj) runs first in doname_base and can update discovery state; js/objnam.js:xnameFresh() is already implemented and its ordering must be preserved.

timeout.c:peek_timer(BURN_OBJECT, &timer) returns an absolute timer expiry that is consumed in the turns_left calculation. js/timeout.js:peek_timer() already returns the matching timer timeout by function index and object identity.

The exercised branch consumes BURN_OBJECT, svm.moves, obj->age, obj->lamplit, objects[obj->otyp].oc_cost, and the Is_candle(obj) classification. Preserve the zeroed anything timer with timer.a_obj = obj.

evidence: Source: frozen checkout 6d2c675aad59f170ec44980d6afce47f08ae7423, nethack-c/upstream/src/objnam.c:1223-1751 is the complete doname_base() function. Its candle arm at :1456-1477 calculates full burn time from objects[].oc_cost and, for a lit candle, adjusts stored age using peek_timer(BURN_OBJECT) - svm.moves before deciding whether to add "partly used".

Source caller: nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:6388 calls doname(otmp) to build the wish-result string before hold_another_object() at :6419. objnam.c:1753-1757 routes doname() to doname_base(). The command route is cmd.c:2000-2001 -> wizcmds.c:32-40 -> zap.c:makewish().

Diagnostic: .cache/synthetic-scans/v15/wizard-throws-magic-marker-during-lit-candle-probe.json reports a stop at segment 0, step 25 with "unsupported object name branch: lit candle timer adjustment". The current source-root implementation reaches this refusal in js/objnam.js:448-449 before formatting the candle; js/timeout.js:1155-1161 already ports peek_timer().

C recording: challenges/cases/v15/wizard-throws-magic-marker-during-lit-candle-probe.session.json has 29 steps. At step 25, the wish answer produces "o - a candle (lit).". The recipe then issues throw, selects n, and gives direction l. n selects the Wizard starter magic marker from the Wizard inventory in nethack-c/upstream/src/u_init.c:168-176; it is not the wished candle at o. Thus the recorded play reaches a marker throw, not a lit-candle throw.

Later source path: dothrow.c:351-375 dispatches the throw selection and :1818 calls (void) snuff_candle(obj) after floor effects. For the selected magic marker, apply.c:1472-1494 returns false before any output or timer change because it is neither a candle nor the candelabrum. js/dothrow.js:2693 still records note_unported("apply.c snuff_candle") on this later marker-landing path. A throw of the lit candle at o would exercise snuff_candle() side effects, but this recording does not provide evidence for that branch.
